answers.explanation: The mail user agent is the program a person reads and writes mail in.
The mail transfer agent: Sendmail, Postfix, Exim, Exchange.
The mail delivery agent does the last step on the receiving server.
SMTP moves mail toward the recipient. Reading it uses IMAP or POP.
The mail submission agent accepts new mail from authenticated users.
Store and forward: the message waits in a queue until the next hop takes it.
It keeps the message queued and retries, typically for days, before bouncing it.
AUTODIN stored whole messages at relay centers and forwarded them on, just like mail servers do.
A bounce, also called a non-delivery report (NDR).
